analysis.title: GS Kamshad - GS TMT Today 10.28.26
key_insights: FOMC day. Markets expect a hold today and a hike in December. WIRP shows an 11% chance of a hike at this meeting. Decision is at 2 PM ET.

NDX futures were +35 bps in the morning note (+50 bps in the macro section) against R2K futures -15 bps (-20 bps in the macro section). AI, tech and semis are trying to sustain the global rally, and KOSPI was +7% overnight after SK Hynix results.
Rates and oil are at stressed levels. The US 10-year yield is back at about 5.0% (5.009%), the 2-year is 4.747%, Brent topped $116 and WTI is $101.58, and the USD continues to strengthen (DXY 102.4).

SK Hynix 3Q operating profit was W83.3tn against BBGe W76.9tn and GSe W77.5tn. The stock started mild on a W20tn buyback against W30-40tn Street expectations, then recovered on the call. Management said the memory shortage should last through 2030, DRAM capacity is largely sold out through 2029, and long-term agreements cover more than 50% of 2027-2028 capacity.
Memory read-through was positive: MU +4%, DRAM +5%, NVDA +75 bps premarket. Samsung's 3Q call is tomorrow at 10am KST, where investors want more detail on shareholder returns.

Seagate beat slightly on F1Q and guided F2Q well above the Street (revenue $4.80 bn vs Street $4.50 bn, operating EPS $9.20 vs Street $8.54), but the stock fell after the print against elevated expectations following WDC. Price per exabyte rose about 33% y/y and management expects strong pricing through FY27.

Teradyne's quarter and 4Q guide were slightly ahead of the Street against elevated expectations. The stock was flat premarket. Product Test revenue ($138 mn) was well above the Street, while Robotics ($96 mn) missed.

Etsy reported a beat and raise. GMS growth accelerated to +9.1% y/y constant currency from +7.2%, active buyers grew y/y for the first time in two years, and the FY GMS guide was raised to about 7%. A CFO change was announced.

Overnight AI-infrastructure prints were strong: VRT +15% (Americas organic accelerated to 66%), UCTT +14% on beat/raise, FLEX +10% on a higher FY revenue guide, GEV +5% on guidance and a buyback raised from $10bn to $20bn.

Decliners reflected guidance or bookings disappointments: NXPI -7% on in-line guidance, CSGP -7% as bookings weaken, FFIV -5% as Systems growth is weighted to F1H27 while refresh tailwinds slow, HOOD -8% on mixed results, STX -4%, ST -3% on China auto weakness.
GS research on NXPI expects the stock modestly lower after an in-line quarter but keeps Buy. The ~10% of shares outstanding buyback authorization and achievable 2027 targets support the thesis.

American Tower beat EBITDA slightly ($1.83 bn) and stepped up buybacks, but US organic tenant billings missed and 2026 service revenue guidance was cut to about $220 mn from $245 mn. The Canadian tower sale should be immediately accretive to AFFO per share. GS stays Buy on data center momentum and capital allocation.

Onsemi is reportedly in talks to buy chip startup Ferric for close to $1 billion, per The Information. A deal could come together in the coming days, and the structure may include performance-based payments.
Brent topped $116 after the White House warned Gulf allies to prepare for a possible short-but-intense military campaign against Iran after the midterms.

Heavy event calendar today: ORCL investor day (11:55am ET), AAPL product event (1pm), MNDY investor session (2pm), FOMC (2pm), then post-close earnings from GOOGL, MSFT, NOW, KLAC, EBAY, EQIX, FTNT, TMUS, TYL and others. Tomorrow brings core PCE, GDP, the ECB and BOJ decisions plus AMZN, INTC, COIN and SBUX earnings.

market_movers.rationale: GS expects the stock modestly lower after an in-line quarter and guidance short of bullish expectations. It sees 2027 targets as achievable and a buyback authorization of about 10% of shares outstanding as supportive.
GS cites data center momentum, the larger repurchase plan and the accretive Canadian tower sale. US organic tenant billings growth missed and service revenue guidance was lowered.
Piper Sandler downgrade to Neutral. GS views the F2027 EPS outlook as in line and expects the stock may trade lower as Systems growth is F1H27 weighted and refresh tailwinds slow.
DZ Bank upgrade to Hold, listed under Street actions.
Presidential Capital Management downgrade to Neutral, listed under Street actions.
Hon Hai (Taiwan listing) is Buy rated in GS's 3-month preview of the AI server/PC supply chain.
Wiwynn (Taiwan listing) is Buy rated in GS's 3-month preview of the AI server/PC supply chain.
Wistron (Taiwan listing) is Buy rated in GS's 3-month preview of the AI server/PC supply chain.
Quanta, Inventec, Compal and ASUS (Taiwan listings) are Neutral rated by GS.
Pegatron (Taiwan listing) is the only Sell in GS's Taiwan ODM/Brands coverage.

sector_views.rationale: GS is positive on Apple's supply chain from new models with form factor changes, AI server components riding specification upgrades, and rising ASIC AI server penetration.

earnings_insights: SK Hynix 3Q operating profit W83.3tn reported vs BBGe W76.9tn and GSe W77.5tn (about 8% beat). Buyback W20tn announced vs Street W30-40tn. 2026 total shareholder return to reach W100tn, in line with estimates.

Seagate F1Q reported: revenue $4.23 bn vs GS $4.20 bn and Street $4.14 bn, gross margin 57.8% vs GS 57.2% and Street 57.6%, operating EPS $7.68 vs GS $7.59 and Street $7.42. F2Q guide (midpoint): revenue $4.80 bn vs GS $4.60 bn and Street $4.50 bn, operating EPS $9.20 vs GS $8.66 and Street $8.54, operating margin mid-50% vs Street 52.9%. Exabyte growth 21% y/y, price per exabyte about +33% y/y.

Teradyne reported: revenue $1.31 bn vs GS $1.30 bn and Street $1.27 bn, non-GAAP EPS $2.29 vs GS $2.15 and Street $2.05, gross margin 59.1%. 4Q guide: revenue $1.30 bn midpoint vs Street $1.28 bn, non-GAAP EPS $1.95-$2.25 (midpoint $2.10) vs GS $2.03 and Street $2.05.

Etsy reported: marketplace GMS +9.1% y/y cc (from +7.2%), EBITDA margin 30.4%. FY GMS guide raised to about 7% y/y from mid-single digits, EBITDA margin guide 30% vs prior 29-30%. CFO change announced.

American Tower 3Q26 reported EBITDA $1.83 bn vs GSe $1.82 bn and Visible Alpha consensus $1.82 bn. Repurchases $300mn vs GSe $100mn, new $2.0bn repurchase plan. 2026 service revenue guide cut to about $220 mn from $245 mn. 4Q26 domestic new business expected near the 3Q26 level of $25 mn vs consensus $33 mn.

Sensata 3Q reported revenue, operating income and adjusted EPS slightly above GS and the Street excluding an EV termination payment. 4Q EPS guide in line with the Street at the midpoint on modestly lower revenue guidance from weaker China auto trends. 7 design wins across 6 hyperscale customers, ramps from mid-2027.
NXPI quarter in line with guidance short of the most bullish expectations. Buyback authorization now about 10% of shares outstanding. Stock -7% pre-market per the movers list.
FFIV F4Q26 results strong in Systems and Software, but F2027 EPS outlook in line with GS. Systems growth weighted to F1H27 and no F2027 EBIT margin upside.

Other overnight moves: VRT +15% (Americas organic accelerated to 66%, 100% order growth cited in the macro section), UCTT +14% beat/raise, FLEX +10% raised FY revenue guide, GEV +5% on guidance raise and buyback increased from $10bn to $20bn, TEL uncalled 4QFY26 orders +29% y/y, CSGP -7% as bookings weaken, HOOD -8% mixed results.

Post-close earnings today: ALKT, CVNA, EBAY, EQIX, ETSY, FTNT, GEN, GOOGL, KLAC, MSFT, NOW, OLED, TMUS, TYL, WEX. Tomorrow pre: ALGM, CAT, CTSH, ENTG, MA, MBLY, SIRI, STM. Tomorrow post: AMZN, COIN, DLR, INTC, MPWR, PINS, RBLX, RDDT, RIVN, SBUX, SNDK, TWLO.

Released Thursday 10/29 alongside GDP, ECB and BOJ decisions. A hot print would reinforce the December hike pricing.

Elevated expectations in AI hardware names, where beats and raises (STX, TER) are met with flat or lower prices.
Weakening China auto demand (Sensata) and softer US organic tenant billings growth (American Tower).

Stocks that beat and raised against elevated expectations (STX, TER) were flat to lower, while VRT, UCTT and FLEX rallied on upside surprises.

Korea flows: foreigners and local institutions were joint net buyers in Hynix (+$288mn/+$177mn) and Samsung (+$280mn/+$297mn), while retail investors took profit (-$463mn in Hynix, -$564mn in Samsung).
Most active high touch names: NFLX, VZ, NOW, APH, NBIS, ORCL, ALGM, PAYX, GEN.
geopolitical: The White House warned Gulf allies to prepare for a possible short-but-intense military campaign against Iran after the midterms, and Brent topped $116.
Weaker China auto market trends cut Sensata's 4Q revenue guidance.
Oil and Brent are stubbornly at the highs (about $115/brl) on quieter overnight macro newsflow.

tension_points.bull_case: Operating profit beat the Street by about 8%, management said the memory shortage continues through 2030, DRAM capacity is largely sold out through 2029, and LTAs cover more than 50% of 2027-2028 capacity.
tension_points.bear_case: The W20tn buyback was below Street expectations of W30-40tn, which drove the mild initial price action before the call.

tension_points.bull_case: F2Q guidance is well above the Street (operating EPS $9.20 vs $8.54) and pricing per exabyte is up about 33% y/y.
tension_points.bear_case: Expectations were elevated following WDC, and the stock fell 4% on a beat/raise quarter.

tension_points.what_invalidates: 4Q26 domestic new business near the 3Q26 level of $25 mn versus consensus $33 mn would pressure the ability to reach the ~250bps contribution to FY26E domestic organic tenant billings growth.
